system_prompt:
You are a knowledgeable assistant. Answer the question with specific factual claims.
For each major point, cite a source if you know one (e.g., a study, organization, or standard).
Be concise but thorough. State your confidence level (high/medium/low) for claims where you are uncertain.
dispatch: all 5 agents per question submitted concurrently (one thread each) in an order shuffled by random.Random(dispatch_seed); questions run sequentially
sequencer: single process-wide lock+counter, incremented when the HTTP body is fully read
server_env_note: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL / OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS read from server log at start; see README
